bare_soil_days.definition: Off-season days with no planned living cover.
bare_soil_days.rationale: The same principle as living cover days, seen from the other side.

crop_family_diversity.definition: Distinct plant families among every crop in the candidate.

family_source.title: Botanical family by genus (APG IV; USDA PLANTS Database)

crop_family_diversity.rationale: Species diversification through varied crop sequences.

dry_pre_plant_frequency.definition: Share of evaluable seasons whose 30 days before planting were dry (bottom 20% of this cell's own totals for that window).
dry_pre_plant_frequency.rationale: How often this planting window started dry in this cell's history; it describes the window's weather, not the plan's effect on it.

source.title: A.C.R.E dry pre-plant window: bottom 20% of this cell's own 1981-2025 30-day totals (calculation)

heavy_rain_days_on_bare_soil.definition: Median per-season count of heavy-rain days with no planned living cover (NC: 76.2 mm; elsewhere the cell's ETCCDI R95p value).
heavy_rain_days_on_bare_soil.rationale: Intense rain on uncovered soil; a count of weather events, not damage.

irrigation_dependence.definition: Not computed: there is no sourced crop water-need table yet.
irrigation_dependence.rationale: Listed so the gap is visible; never used for a shortlist.

living_cover_days.definition: Planned living-cover days (cover crop seed to termination, or growing winter grain). Planned; establishment uncertain.
living_cover_days.rationale: Keep the soil covered and living roots in it as long as possible.

management_operations.definition: Planned field operations per season: previous harvest and next planting, plus cover seed and termination or winter-grain planting and harvest.
management_operations.rationale: A plain count used only for the management-simplicity priority; not a cost or labour estimate.

modeled_root_zone_wetness_at_planting.definition: Median over seasons of mean modeled root-zone wetness (GWETROOT) in the 30 days before planting.
modeled_root_zone_wetness_at_planting.rationale: Modeled soil water near planting. The same for any plan with the same planting date; not a water saving.

source.title: NASA POWER parameter GWETROOT (MERRA-2 root-zone soil wetness)

rain_on_bare_soil_mm.definition: Median per-season rain on off-season days with no planned living cover.
rain_on_bare_soil_mm.rationale: Rain on uncovered soil is what soil cover is meant to intercept. Rainfall depth only: not erosion, runoff or soil loss.

rule_flags.definition: Per leg, the distinct catalog rule checks that flagged in at least one past season plus the rule lines that need a manual check (the winter-wheat path's lines included); mean over legs. Unevaluable rules are listed, not counted. Each rule cites its own source.
rule_flags.rationale: Published guidance that would have asked for a check or a change.
rule_flags.reason: some rules could not be evaluated (unknown)

method.ordering_text: For each indicator the shortlisted plans are ranked (1 = best, ties share a rank); they are listed by the sum of weight x rank position. Raw values of different indicators are never combined.

heavy_rain.name: heavy_rain_mm
heavy_rain.note: Applied to NASA POWER daily values, which are Local Solar Time days (time_standard=LST), not a rolling 24-hour window; a storm split across two solar days can fall below the value on each day. Rainfall-depth weather metric only: not erosion, runoff or soil loss. Zero-count winters are valid results.

parameters.scope: rainfall depth only; not erosion or soil loss
